description: If \(T\) has isolating refinements, \(\Gamma\) is a finite satisfiable condition in countably many fresh names, and \(\bar c\) is any finite tuple of these names, then some isolator \(\psi\) can be added at that same tuple so that \(T+\Gamma+\{\psi(\bar c)\}\) remains satisfiable. Repeated names and the empty tuple are allowed.
